So now: from the first of November the intake rota runs fortnightly, with a fifteen-minute call at each hand-off, and the pantry restocks a shelf once it falls below a third full. Both begin on the same day.

Priya Holm said on the October 1 team call: "The intake rota moves to fortnightly in November, with a fifteen-minute overlap call at each hand-off."

Dario Kent said in the same call: "The pantry restocks any shelf when it falls below a third full."

Priya closed with "Both start on the first of November."

My read is that the hand-off calls need slots on the November calendar before the rota itself does, since they are the part that has to happen on the first day. If the third-full rule holds, that suggests pantry restocking will be triggered by shelf level rather than by a schedule, which is a different habit for the team to build. It also suggests that anyone covering intake in the first fortnight starts with the new hand-off already in place.

Does the fifteen-minute overlap apply to every hand-off, or only the ones between intake shifts? Does the third-full rule have a count of shelves behind it, or is it judged by eye?
